    r._measurement == "interface_legacy" and
    (r._field == "ifInOctets" or r._field == "ifOutOctets")
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 8.0 }))

  |> sum(column: "_value")

        |> range(start: -10m)

            r._measurement == "snmp" and
            r._field == "sysUpTime"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["source"])
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            SwitchIP: string(v: r.source),
            LastSeen: r._time,
            AgeSeconds: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0
        }))
        |> group(columns: ["SwitchIP"])

    join.left(
        left: expected,
        right: live,
        on: (l, r) => l.SwitchIP == r.SwitchIP,
        as: (l, r) => ({
            SwitchIP: l.SwitchIP,
            Building: l.Building,
            Role: l.Role,
            DeviceType: l.DeviceType,
            IsOnline:
                if exists r.AgeSeconds then
                    if r.AgeSeconds <= 300.0 then 1
                    else 0
                else 0
        })
    )

joined

    |> reduce(
        identity: {Online: 0, Total: 0},
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
            Online: accumulator.Online + r.IsOnline,
            Total: accumulator.Total + 1
        })

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "interface" and
    (r._field == "ifHCInOctets" or r._field == "ifHCOutOctets") and
    (
      r.source == "192.168.2.70" or
      r.source == "192.168.2.71" or
      r.source == "192.168.2.72" or
      r.source == "192.168.2.73"
    )
  )
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> tail(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      switch:
        if r.source == "192.168.2.70" then "sw-aa144-A48" else
        if r.source == "192.168.2.71" then "sw-aa144-A24" else
        if r.source == "192.168.2.72" then "sw-t122-T24" else
        if r.source == "192.168.2.73" then "sw-t122-T48" else
        r.source,
      _value: r._value * 8.0
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["switch"])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> yield(name: "nexus_current_bps_by_switch")

names_base = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp" and r._field == "sysUpTime" and (r.source == "192.168.2.70" or r.source == "192.168.2.71" or r.source == "192.168.2.72" or r.source == "192.168.2.73"))
  |> group(columns: ["source"]) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with name: if exists r.sysName then string(v: r.sysName) else r.source }))
  |> keep(columns: ["source", "name"])

adm_all = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "if_status_errors" and r._field == "ifAdminStatus" and (r.source == "192.168.2.70" or r.source == "192.168.2.71" or r.source == "192.168.2.72" or r.source == "192.168.2.73"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => int(v: r._value) == 1)
  |> group(columns: ["source"]) |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "admin_up"})

opr_all = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "if_status_errors" and r._field == "ifOperStatus" and (r.source == "192.168.2.70" or r.source == "192.168.2.71" or r.source == "192.168.2.72" or r.source == "192.168.2.73"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => int(v: r._value) == 1)
  |> group(columns: ["source"]) |> count()
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "oper_up"})

ports = join(tables: {a: adm_all, b: opr_all}, on: ["source"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with down_ports: if float(v: r.admin_up) - float(v: r.oper_up) < 0.0 then 0.0 else float(v: r.admin_up) - float(v: r.oper_up) }))
  |> keep(columns: ["source", "admin_up", "oper_up", "down_ports"])

uptime = from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "snmp" and r._field == "sysUpTime" and (r.source == "192.168.2.70" or r.source == "192.168.2.71" or r.source == "192.168.2.72" or r.source == "192.168.2.73"))
  |> group(columns: ["source"]) |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with uptime_days: float(v: r._value) / 100.0 / 86400.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["source", "uptime_days"])

base = join(tables: {a: names_base, b: uptime}, on: ["source"])
final = join(tables: {a: base, b: ports}, on: ["source"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with ip: r.source, name: if r.name == "" then r.source else r.name, health_score: if r.down_ports > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["ip", "name", "uptime_days", "admin_up", "oper_up", "down_ports", "health_score"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["down_ports", "ip"], desc: true)

final

recent_switches =
    from(bucket: "telegraf")
        |> range(start: -15m)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "snmp" and
            r._field == "sysUpTime"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["source"])
        |> last()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            SwitchIP: string(v: r.source),
            OnlineFlag: 1
        }))
        |> group(columns: ["SwitchIP"])

switch_counts =
    join.left(
        left: expected_switches,
        right: recent_switches,
        on: (l, r) => l.SwitchIP == r.SwitchIP,
        as: (l, r) => ({
            SwitchIP: l.SwitchIP,
            DeviceType: l.DeviceType,
            ExpectedCount: 1,
            OnlineCount: if exists r.OnlineFlag then r.OnlineFlag else 0
        })
    )
    |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])
    |> reduce(
        identity: {DeviceType: "", ExpectedCount: 0, OnlineCount: 0},
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
            DeviceType: if accumulator.DeviceType != "" then accumulator.DeviceType else r.DeviceType,
            ExpectedCount: accumulator.ExpectedCount + r.ExpectedCount,
            OnlineCount: accumulator.OnlineCount + r.OnlineCount
        })
    )

expected_ups =
    from(bucket: "telegraf")
        |> range(start: -90d)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "ups" and
            r._field == "ups_up"
        )
        |> group(columns: ["building", "ups_name"])
        |> last()
        |> group(columns: [])
        |> count(column: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            DeviceType: "UPS",
            ExpectedCount: int(v: r._value),
            OnlineCount: 0
        }))

    from(bucket: "telegraf")
        |> range(start: -24h)
        |> filter(fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "ups" and
            r._field == "ups_up"

        |> group(columns: ["building", "ups_name"])
        |> last()
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
        |> group(columns: [])
        |> count(column: "_value")
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({
            DeviceType: "UPS",
            ExpectedCount: 0,
            OnlineCount: int(v: r._value)
        }))

ups_counts =
    union(tables: [expected_ups, online_ups])
        |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])
        |> reduce(
            identity: {DeviceType: "UPS", ExpectedCount: 0, OnlineCount: 0},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
                DeviceType: "UPS",
                ExpectedCount: accumulator.ExpectedCount + r.ExpectedCount,
                OnlineCount: accumulator.OnlineCount + r.OnlineCount
            })
        )

all_counts =
    union(tables: [switch_counts, ups_counts])
        |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])

    array.from(
        rows: [
            {DeviceType: "Aruba"},
            {DeviceType: "Cisco"},
            {DeviceType: "Fortigate"},
            {DeviceType: "UPS"}
        ]
    )
    |> group(columns: ["DeviceType"])

join.left(
    left: device_types,
    right: all_counts,
    on: (l, r) => l.DeviceType == r.DeviceType,
    as: (l, r) => ({
        DeviceType: l.DeviceType,
        Online:
            if exists r.OnlineCount then r.OnlineCount else 0,
        Offline:
            if exists r.ExpectedCount and exists r.OnlineCount then r.ExpectedCount - r.OnlineCount
            else if exists r.ExpectedCount then r.ExpectedCount
            else 0
    })
)
    |> group(columns: [])
    |> sort(columns: ["DeviceType"])
    |> keep(columns: ["DeviceType", "Online", "Offline"])

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "FortigateA-Sccc.sccc.edu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sysName == "FortigateA-Sccc.sccc.edu")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["hc_name"])
